# Magento Open Source / Adobe Commerce MCP Server

This is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that connects to a Magento Open Source or Adobe Commerce REST API making possible Claude, OpenAI Agent Builder and other MCP clients to request supported Magento REST API endpoints. This server support both local and remote HTTPS connection.

## Benefits

- **Broader API coverage (read + write):** enables agents to not only retrieve data, but also update content and product data when appropriate.
- **Multi-store aware:** supports working across multiple store views / websites from a single MCP connection.
- **Compact responses (default):** returns lean payloads to reduce token usage and, in turn, LLM costs.
- **SearchCriteria support for advanced querying:** enables complex filtering/sorting/pagination for “data mining” style requests.
- **Secure remote connectivity (HTTPS):** supports connecting agents over the internet (e.g., Agent Builder / remote MCP usage).

## Installation and running:

1. Install [nodejs](https://nodejs.org/en) 20 and above
2. Create Integration access token via admin interface of your Magento Open Source/Adobe Commerce store

```
System -> Extensions -> Integrations -> Add new integration
```
3. Clone this repo

```
git clone git@github.com:magenable/magento-adobe-commerce-mcp-server.git
```
4. Go to workdir

```
cd magento-adobe-commerce-mcp-server
```
5. Install dependencies

```
npm install
```
6. Copy and fill .env

```
cp .env.sample .env
```
7. Generate JWT Token

```
npm run jwt:generate username
```
8. Starting HTTP server

```
npm run start:http
```

 or use [pm2](https://pm2.keymetrics.io/)

```
pm2 start "npm run start:http" --name mcp-magento
```
OpenAI need HTTPS connection and domain. You can use NGINX as a reverse proxy and install a certificate, for example, via certbot

### Testing

You can run tests using commands

`npm run test:http` or `npm run test:stdio` for tests that DO NOT CHANGE data

`npm run test:http:unsafe` or `npm run test:stdio:unsafe` for tests that CHANGE data or trigger emails a user and may be unsafe in production

An HTTP/stdio server will be launched, a client will be created, which will connect to the server and sequentially launch tools for obtaining data.

The tests/tools.js file contains all tools divided into two groups - safe and those that change/create data. This file can also be used to configure the arguments that will be passed to the tool during tests.

Example outputs:

```
search_customers_by_search_criteria
OK
```

```
search_address_by_address_id
ERROR: 404 Not Found No such entity with %fieldName = %fieldValue
{ fieldName: 'addressId', fieldValue: 1 }
```

```
search_cms_content_by_search_criteria
ERROR: 401 Unauthorized The consumer isn't authorized to access %resources.
{ resources: 'Magento_Cms::page' }
```

### The project implements the use of SearchCriteria

For example, a request below will be converted into a SearchCriteria object and passed to the API

`find simple products with visibility =4 and with price < 50, 5 results from first page. show image, name, link, price, category (with link if possible) and description`

```
{
  searchCriteria: {
    filterGroups: [
      {
        filters: [
          { field: 'type_id', value: 'simple', condition_type: 'eq' },
          { field: 'visibility', value: '4', condition_type: 'eq' },
          { field: 'price', value: '50', condition_type: 'lt' }
        ]
      }
    ],
    pageSize: 5,
    currentPage: 1
  }
}
```

This approach allows you to use multiple search criteria or different search fields using only one endpoint.

### Connect with OpenAi Agent Builder

- Login to platform.openai.com
- Go to [https://platform.openai.com/agent-builder](https://platform.openai.com/agent-builder)
- Edit Workflow
- Add MCP workflow module
- Add server
- Configure connection

`URL` - [https://example.com/mcp](https://example.com/mcp)

`Authentication` - Access token / API key

`Add your access token` - JWT token from point 7
